title: Earth Observations taken by the Expedition 18 Crew
author: NASA/JSC
description: ISS018-E-035716 (24 Feb. 2009) --- Minchinmavida and Chaiten Volcanoes in Chile are featured in this image photographed by an Expedition 18 crewmember on the International Space Station. The Andes mountain chain along the western coastline of South America includes numerous active stratovolcanoes.
